map.压差 ΔP=进口-出口；相对密度 SG=密度÷1.29；计算 Cv=流量÷√(Δ: Pressure differential ΔP = inlet - outlet; relative density SG = density÷1.29; Cv = flow÷√(ΔP/SG); the selection Cv is 1.3 times the calculated value; a pressure ratio P2/P1 ≤0.528 is critical flow and must be checked with the gas expansion formula.
